definitions.explanation: The administrative office of a city government where residents can access various municipal services.

examples.japanese: {市役所|しやくしょ}で{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}を{取|と}る。
examples.english: I get a certificate of residence at city hall.

examples.japanese: {市役所|しやくしょ}は{駅|えき}の{近|ちか}くにある。
examples.english: City hall is near the station.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したら{市役所|しやくしょ}に{届|とど}け{出|で}をしなければならない。
examples.english: When you move, you must file a notification at city hall.

notes:
{市役所|しやくしょ} combines {市|し} (city) + {役所|やくしょ} (government office).

RELATED GOVERNMENT OFFICES:
- {区役所|くやくしょ} (ward office - in Tokyo, etc.)
- {町役場|まちやくば}/{村役場|むらやくば} (town/village office)
- {県庁|けんちょう} (prefectural office)

COMMON SERVICES:
- {住民票|じゅうみんひょう} (certificate of residence)
- {戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん} (family register copy)
- {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ} (move-in notification)
- {印鑑|いんかん}{登録|とうろく} (seal registration)

USAGE NOTES:
- An essential word for anyone living in Japan
- Various forms and certificates must be obtained here
